title: 9 Best Herbal Tinctures For Psoriasis
intro: Herbal tinctures for Psoriasis are concentrated liquid extracts made from plants, used to treat this chronic skin condition by reducing inflammation and promoting healing. These tinctures offer numerous benefits, including reducing scaling, redness, and itching associated with Psoriasis, as well as promoting overall skin health. Various herbal tinctures have been found effective in treating Psoriasis, such as Aloe Vera tincture which soothes and calms the skin, Turmeric tincture which reduces inflammation and oxidative stress, and St. John's Wort tincture which promotes wound healing and skin regeneration. Additionally, other herbal tinctures like Calendula, Tea Tree, and Ginger have also been used to treat Psoriasis due to their antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties.

preparations.preparation_desc: Silybum marianum tinctures have been used in traditional medicine to treat psoriasis due to their anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The tinctures are believed to help treat psoriasis by reducing inflammation and promoting the healing of skin lesions. The bioactive constituents of Silybum marianum, including flavonoids and saponins, are thought to contribute to its therapeutic effects by modulating immune responses and reducing oxidative stress. By utilizing Silybum marianum tinctures, individuals may experience benefits such as improved skin health, reduced itching and scaling, and enhanced overall well-being.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "American journal of clinical dermatology", Silybum marianum tinctures for psoriasis are not mentioned in the study, however, some plant-derived substances like dithranol and methoxsalen (8-methoxypsoralen) [in combination with UVA] are already accepted as standard treatments in psoriasis; but it is suggested that Mahonia and Capsicum (capsaicin) are the next candidates, implying that Silybum marianum tinctures are not yet considered a standard treatment, but may have potential for use in psoriasis.

preparations.preparation_desc: Urtica dioica tinctures, derived from the stinging nettle plant, have been traditionally used to treat psoriasis due to their anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory properties. The tannins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids present in this herbal preparation help to reduce inflammation and modulate the immune system, which is beneficial in treating psoriasis. The tannins in Urtica dioica tinctures also help to reduce the proliferation of skin cells, thereby reducing the scaly patches associated with psoriasis. By reducing inflammation and modulating the immune system, Urtica dioica tinctures can provide relief from the symptoms of psoriasis, such as redness, itching, and scaling, making it a potential natural remedy for this condition.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "American journal of clinical dermatology", Urtica dioica tinctures for psoriasis may be considered alongside dithranol and methoxsalen (8-methoxypsoralen) in combination with UVA as they are already accepted as standard treatments in psoriasis.

preparations.preparation_desc: Hypericum perforatum tinctures, also known as St. John's Wort, have been used to treat psoriasis due to its anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory properties. The tincture helps to reduce inflammation and modulate the immune system, which can help to alleviate symptoms of psoriasis such as redness and scaling. The bioactive constituents of Hypericum perforatum, including hyperforin and hypericin, have been shown to inhibit the production of pro-inflammatory cytokines and promote the production of anti-inflammatory cytokines, which can help to reduce inflammation and promote healing. Regular use of Hypericum perforatum tinctures may help to reduce the severity and frequency of psoriasis symptoms, providing relief and improving the quality of life for individuals suffering from this condition.
preparations.preparation_study: According to the study, Hypericum perforatum tinctures for psoriasis may be used as a potential therapeutic adjuvant, either alone or in combination with other treatments, to improve the quality of life of patients with plaque psoriasis.

preparations.preparation_desc: Calendula officinalis tinctures have been traditionally used to treat the symptoms of psoriasis, a chronic inflammatory skin condition characterized by red, scaly patches. The anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties of calendula, particularly its sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, help to reduce inflammation and prevent infection, thereby alleviating symptoms of psoriasis. By promoting wound healing, reducing redness and itching, and inhibiting the growth of skin cells, calendula tinctures can help to improve the appearance and comfort of affected skin, providing relief from the discomfort and distress associated with psoriasis. The benefits of using calendula tinctures to treat psoriasis include reduced inflammation, improved skin integrity, and enhanced overall skin health, making it a valuable natural remedy for managing this condition.
preparations.preparation_study: According to the study, Calendula officinalis tinctures for psoriasis may be used as a potential therapeutic adjuvant to improve the quality of life of patients.

preparations.preparation_desc: Aloe vera tinctures have been traditionally used to treat psoriasis, a chronic skin condition characterized by red, scaly patches. The anti-inflammatory and soothing properties of aloe vera tinctures help to calm and reduce inflammation in the affected skin, providing relief from itching and discomfort. The bioactive constituents of aloe vera, such as aloin, aloe-emodin, and acemannan, have been shown to possess potent anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory effects, which help to reduce the severity of psoriasis symptoms. By using aloe vera tinctures, individuals with psoriasis may experience reduced redness, scaling, and itching, as well as improved skin texture and overall skin health.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Tropical medicine & international health : TM & IH", Aloe vera tinctures for psoriasis showed a significant clinical efficacy in curing patients with psoriasis vulgaris, with 83.3% (25/30 patients) of those treated with 0.5% Aloe vera extract in a hydrophilic cream showing a cured response.
